missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Заболевание' is a neuter -ие noun in the nominative as the predicate. 'Серьёзное' is the agreeing neuter adjective. A clean diagnostic statement.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Заболевание' is the accusative direct object of 'вылечил', identical to the nominative for this neuter noun. 'Врач' is the subject, and 'быстро' adds manner. A treatment phrase.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Заболевания' is the genitive after 'нет', and 'серьёзного' agrees in the neuter genitive. The frame 'у него' shows whose condition it is. A reassuring phrase.
Strategic focus: Prepositional after 'о'. 'О заболевании' uses the neuter prepositional 'заболевании' to mean about the disease. 'Его' is the unchanging possessive. A consultation pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental predicate inverted. 'Причиной' is the instrumental after 'стало', while 'заболевание' is the nominative subject. 'Редкое' agrees in neuter. A cause-and-effect frame.
Strategic focus: Dative with 'подвержены'. 'Заболеванию' is the dative governed by 'подвержены' to mean susceptible to the disease. 'Этому' agrees in the neuter dative. A risk-group phrase.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'от'. 'Заболевания' is the genitive required by 'от' to mean depends on the disease. 'Лечение' is the neuter nominative subject. A medical-logic sentence.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Заболевания' is the nominative plural as the subject of 'требуют'. 'Хронические' agrees in the plural, and 'внимания' is genitive after 'требуют'. Shows the plural.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Заболевания' is the accusative plural object of 'изучают', identical to the nominative plural for this inanimate neuter noun. 'Новые' agrees in the plural. A research phrase.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Заболевание' is the neuter nominative subject of 'прошло', which agrees in neuter. 'Без осложнений' is a genitive plural after 'без'. A recovery phrase.
